basic_details.job_title: UERC Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Uttarakhand Electricity Regulatory Commission (UERC) has invited applications for three Assistant Director (Group-B) posts on direct recruitment basis: one each in Technical, Tariff and Law, all unreserved (UR) and at Pay Level 10. Applications in the Commission's format must be sent by speed post only to the Dy. Director (Administration), UERC, Dehradun, so as to reach by 7 December 2026. The notice is dated 5 November 2026.

qualification.details: The three posts add up to the total of 3. The notice prints the pay as Pay Level 10 and gives no rupee amount. | Graduate Degree in Electrical/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Instrumentation/Electrical & Electronics/Power System/Power Engineering/Mechanical Engineering from recognized university/institution. And M. Tech. from recognized university/institution, or MBA in Power Management from recognized university/institution, or two years PG Diploma in Power Management or PG Programme in Management (Energy) from recognized university/institution. | Graduate Degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or equivalent from a recognized university/institute of repute with Post graduate degree or diploma/MBA in Finance from recognized university/institute of repute. Or CA/ICWA. | Graduate Degree in Law from recognized university/institute of repute. | The Graduate Degree is considered only in the branches specified for each post. No other or equivalent branches are accepted, and the Commission will not entertain queries seeking clarification on this. Age limit: the maximum age limit is 42 years as per State Government rules. Relaxation in the upper age limit applies as per State Government rules. The notice does not print a minimum age. Eligibility and age are determined as on the last date of submission of application. Experience: the notice asks for details of experience "if any" and prints no experience requirement for any post. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

selection_process: The Commission reserves the right to shortlist the applications. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted or called for interview. The notice does not give an interview date
important_instructions: Mere fulfilling the eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be considered for the selection process. Any lobbying or canvassing would disqualify the candidates. Incomplete applications, or applications submitted in a different format, are liable to be summarily rejected. The Commission reserves the right not to fill the posts. In that case the notice of such vacancy will be treated as deferred/cancelled.

content_sections.heading: About UERC
content_sections.text: The Uttarakhand Electricity Regulatory Commission is described in the notice as a statutory body discharging its functions under the provisions of the Electricity Act, 2003. It is located at 'Vidyut Niyamak Bhawan', Near ISBT, PO-Majra, Dehradun-248171. The notice gives its website as www.uerc.uk.gov.in and its e-mail as [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application format and details may be downloaded from the Commission's website, www.uerc.uk.gov.in . The notice encloses the application format. Address: Dy. Director (Administration), Uttarakhand Electricity Regulatory Commission, 'Vidyut Niyamak Bhawan', Near ISBT, PO-Majra, Dehradun- 248 171. Mode: speed post only. Applications received after the last date or by any other medium will not be considered in any circumstances. Deadline: the application must reach by 7 December 2026. Envelope: write "Application for the Post of Assistant Director (……………..)" (as applicable) on top. Several posts: a candidate applying for more than one post must submit a separate application form with the required documents for each post. One form is valid for one post only. Government and public-sector employees: those in Central/State/UT Government service, or in the service of an Autonomous/Statutory Body, PSU or Corporation on regular basis, should apply through proper channel, with a "No Objection Certificate" from the parent Department. They may also send an advance copy directly to avoid delay, and must produce the No Objection Certificate before the interview, if called.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The three posts add up to the total of 3. The notice prints the pay as Pay Level 10 and gives no rupee amount. Graduate Degree in Electrical/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Instrumentation/Electrical & Electronics/Power System/Power Engineering/Mechanical Engineering from recognized university/institution. And M. Tech. from recognized university/institution, or MBA in Power Management from recognized university/institution, or two years PG Diploma in Power Management or PG Programme in Management (Energy) from recognized university/institution. Graduate Degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or equivalent from a recognized university/institute of repute with Post graduate degree or diploma/MBA in Finance from recognized university/institute of repute. Or CA/ICWA. Graduate Degree in Law from recognized university/institute of repute. The Graduate Degree is considered only in the branches specified for each post. No other or equivalent branches are accepted, and the Commission will not entertain queries seeking clarification on this. Age limit: the maximum age limit is 42 years as per State Government rules. Relaxation in the upper age limit applies as per State Government rules. The notice does not print a minimum age. Eligibility and age are determined as on the last date of submission of application. Experience: the notice asks for details of experience "if any" and prints no experience requirement for any post. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the given format. Self-attested copies of certificates/marks-sheets for educational qualifications, starting from matriculation. Category certificate. Recent passport size photograph. Details of experience, if any. No Objection Certificate from the parent Department, for regular employees of Central/State/UT Government, Autonomous/Statutory Bodies, PSUs or Corporations (to be produced prior to interview, if called).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Commission reserves the right to shortlist the applications. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted or called for interview. The notice does not give an interview date, venue or any test pattern.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in UERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: one each for Assistant Director (Technical), Assistant Director (Tariff) and Assistant Director (Law), all in the UR category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the UERC Assistant Director posts?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Dy. Director (Administration) by 7 December 2026. Applications received after the last date will not be considered in any circumstances.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Assistant Director (Law) at UERC?
faq.answer: The notice requires a Graduate Degree in Law from a recognized university/institute of repute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Assistant Director (Tariff)?
faq.answer: A Graduate Degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or equivalent with a Post graduate degree or diploma/MBA in Finance, or CA/ICWA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 42 years as per State Government rules, counted as on the last date of submission of application. Relaxation in the upper age limit applies as per State Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay for the UERC Assistant Director posts?
faq.answer: All three posts carry Pay Level 10.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for UERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the application format from www.uerc.uk.gov.in, attach the documents named in the notice and send it by speed post only to the Dy. Director (Administration), UERC, Dehradun.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one UERC Assistant Director post?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate application form with the required documents must be submitted for each post, because one form is valid for one post only.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The Commission may shortlist applications, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted or called for interview.

faq.question: Q10. Do government employees need permission to apply?
faq.answer: Regular employees of Central/State/UT Government, Autonomous/Statutory Bodies, PSUs or Corporations should apply through proper channel with a No Objection Certificate from the parent Department. An advance copy may be sent directly, and the certificate must be produced before the interview, if called.
